landing.heroSubtitle: Turn the device you no longer use into cash. Get an instant estimate, send it to us, and collect your money at our store.
landing.ctaBody: Submit your device now and get a preliminary estimate in seconds.

submit.title: Tell Us About It
submit.body: Fill in your device details, grade its condition and upload photos.

estimate.title: Get An Instant Estimate
estimate.body: Our AI values your device from your photos in seconds.

send.title: Send It To Us
send.body: Drop it at one of our stores, or request a courier pickup.

offer.title: Receive Our Offer
offer.body: We inspect the device and send you a firm price to accept or decline.

paid.title: Get Paid
paid.body: Accept and collect your money at our store. Decline and we send it back.

gate.title: Complete your profile first
gate.body: Selling a device ends with us paying you in person, so we need your email address and phone number on file before you can submit a request.

conditionHint.LIKE_NEW: Barely used, no marks, everything works
conditionHint.GOOD: Normal signs of use, fully working
conditionHint.FAIR: Visible wear or a minor fault, still usable
conditionHint.POOR: Heavy damage, or doesn't power on reliably

form.title: Sell Your Device
form.subtitle: Tell us about your device, then choose how to get it to us.
form.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
form.profileReady: Your contact details are ready. We'll reach you at the email and phone below.
form.conditionHint: Be honest — we re-check the device when it arrives, and an accurate grade means an accurate offer.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Storage size, any faults or scratches, what's included (charger, box)…
form.uploadHintRequired: Add at least 1 photo of your device (up to 4) — we value it from what they show.
form.imagesRequired: Add at least one photo of your device.
form.uploadCta: Click to upload or drag and drop
form.deliveryHint: Choose how to get your device to us — this is required to submit your request.
form.pickDelivery: Please choose how to get your device to us.
form.next1: You get an instant preliminary valuation.
form.next3: We send you a firm offer to accept or decline.
form.next4: Accept it and collect your money at our store.

success.title: Sell Request Submitted
success.body: Our team will review your device shortly. You'll receive an email confirmation at
success.estimatePendingBody: Analysing your photos and description. This usually takes a few seconds.
success.estimateDisclaimer: Generated automatically from your photos and description as a rough guide. Our team will inspect your device and send you the final offer before you commit to anything.
success.estimateUnavailableBody: We couldn't prepare a preliminary valuation for this one. Our team will inspect your device and send you a full offer — nothing is delayed.

list.title: My Sell Requests
list.emptyBody: When you offer us a device it'll appear here so you can track its progress.

detail.saveFailed: Couldn't save your choice. Please try again.
detail.actionFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
detail.reviewing: Our team is currently reviewing your request — we've emailed you a confirmation. Next, choose how to get your device to us.
detail.bringToStoreBody: Bring your device to one of our store locations.
detail.noStores: No stores available in your region yet.
detail.courierPickupBody: We'll send a courier to collect your device (fee applies).
detail.courierPaymentPendingBody: Pay the courier pickup fee to schedule the collection of your device — or choose to bring it to a store below instead.
detail.returnPaymentPendingBody: Pay the courier fee to have your device delivered back to you — or collect it from the store for free instead.
detail.awaitingCourier: A courier will collect your device and deliver it to our store. We'll update this page once it arrives.
detail.awaitingDropoff: Please drop your device at {{store}}. We'll start the inspection as soon as we receive it.
detail.underReview: We've received your device and our team is inspecting it. You'll get our offer shortly.
detail.payoutTitle: How would you like to be paid?
detail.payoutStoreBody: Pick up your money in person at the branch handling your device.
detail.payoutWallet: Keep it in my Buyology wallet
detail.payoutWalletBody: Spend the balance on your next Buyology order. Not available just yet.
detail.collectBody: You've accepted our offer. Visit {{store}} with your ID to collect your payment — we'll mark this request as paid once the money is in your hands.
detail.collectBodyNoStore: You've accepted our offer. Bring your ID to any Buyology store to collect your payment — we'll be in touch to confirm the branch holding your device, and we'll mark this request as paid once the money is in your hands.
detail.completed: All done — you've been paid. Thanks for selling to Buyology!
detail.returnBody: You've declined our offer. Choose how you'd like to receive your device back.
detail.returnCourierChosen: A courier will deliver your device back to you.
detail.returnPickupChosen: You can collect your device from the store.
detail.aiEstimateDisclaimer: Generated automatically from your photos and description as a rough guide. Our team will inspect your device and send you the final offer before you commit to anything.
